gitlabIntegration.title: GitLab Integration
gitlabIntegration.connectedDescription: GitLab is connected to your organization. Projects linked to a GitLab repository are scanned on every push.
gitlabIntegration.reconnectRequiredDescription: GitLab no longer accepts this connection: the CybeDefend application was probably revoked on GitLab. Reconnect GitLab to resume scans of linked repositories.
gitlabIntegration.disconnectConfirmLinks: Projects linked to a GitLab repository will no longer be linked to it.
gitlabIntegration.disconnectConfirmPushScans: Automatic scans on push will stop.
gitlabIntegration.disconnectConfirmHistoryKept: Scan history and vulnerabilities are kept.
gitlabIntegration.disconnectError: GitLab could not be disconnected. Try again.
gitlabIntegration.manageRequiresAdmin: Only an organization administrator or manager can reconnect or disconnect GitLab.
